From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>

Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Subject: Kickoff: signing sprint for MSA + Order Form — routing & auth checks

Sally / team —

Thanks again for moving this forward. We're set to close the MSA + Order Form for Acme Cloudworks this week and want to confirm a brief signing plan so we can prepare the DocuSign envelope and clean-copy deliverables. Attached are the redlines we received (Acme_MSA_redlines_v3.docx) and the current Order Form.

High-level ask:
- Confirm primary signers and whether they require notarization or specific authentication (SMS vs access code).
- Confirm whether procurement needs a PO number before we execute.
- If the CFO is unavailable, please confirm the delegate signer by name + title.

Proposed routing (can change based on your requirements):
1) DocuSign envelope — sequential: John Bates (CFO) -> Samantha Lee (Procurement) -> CEO (final sign).
2) If you prefer faster close, we can route two envelopes in parallel (MSA -> Order Form) and reconcile the clean copy after both are signed.

Attachments: Acme_MSA_redlines_v3.docx (docx), MSA_OrderForm_Acme_v2.xlsx (xlsx)

Target timeline: send envelope by EOD Tue (8/24) for signatures by Thursday if possible.

Let me know any constraints and preferred auth method.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0132

--
Redwood Inference — production-first inference platform for LLMs

Ben —

Thanks — we reviewed the attachments. Primary signers are:
- John Bates (CFO) <john.bates@acme.com>
- Samantha Lee (Head of Procurement) <samantha.lee@acme.com>

Procurement note: we will need a PO on file (PO_6789) before Samantha completes signing. Notarization is not required. For authentication we prefer an access code on the DocuSign envelope (more consistent with our legal ops).

If John is unavailable the authorized delegate is: Maria Ortiz (SVP Finance) — please include her in the envelope as an alternative signer.

We should be able to complete by Thursday if you send by Wednesday morning.

—Sally

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>

Date: Tue, 24 Aug 2027 08:11:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff: signing sprint for MSA + Order Form — routing & auth checks

Ben / Marissa —

Quick legal read on Acme's requests and our preferred approach:
- Access-code authentication is fine. Please set a 6-digit access code and share it to Sally offline (avoid embedding in the envelope email body).
- We should avoid parallel envelopes that create multiple executed originals; if speed is important, use a single envelope with sequential routing but allow Samantha (Procurement) to sign concurrently with CEO as a CC-to-sign if your DocuSign template supports it.
- Confirm that the Order Form includes the exact billing address and PO reference (PO_6789). We will add a clause in the clean copy cover page noting the executed timestamps and DocuSign envelope ID for audit.

Redlines: I annotated two commercial items in Acme_MSA_redlines_v3.docx — see Redlines_MSA_v4_comments.pdf (attached). If Acme accepts the annotations we will prepare the clean-copy PDF and route for signatures.

Please confirm the final signer list and desired envelope auth method; copy me when you create the envelope so Legal can monitor the audit trail.

Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>

Sally — thanks for the quick turnaround and Laura for the notes. Per Acme's preference we'll: 
- Use a single envelope with sequential routing but enable Procurement to sign immediately after CFO (nominally parallel within the same envelope template).
- Set a 6-digit access code and circulate it to your legal ops (Sally) via encrypted Slack / secure channel.
- Include Maria Ortiz as the alternate signer; we'll add her as an optional recipient in the envelope.

Action items (Ben):
- Prepare the clean-copy PDF with Laura's cover page and attach the PO (PO_6789.pdf).
- Create DocuSign envelope (skeleton link below) and set access-code auth; route John Bates -> Samantha Lee -> CEO (final). Add Maria Ortiz as alternate for John.
- Target send: Wed 2027-08-25 09:00 PT. Finish routing and confirm back to Legal and Procurement.

DocuSign skeleton (draft): https://www.docusign.com/envelope/placeholder/ENVELOPE-12345
Drive: https://drive.google.com/open?id=drivefile123

If anyone sees a compliance or billing blocker, flag now. Otherwise I'll send the envelope tomorrow morning.

Thanks,
Ben
